name: intro
text: SoundSight combines sound direction, speaker verification and pan–tilt control for local acoustic interaction. Localization estimates azimuth and elevation, not source distance.

name: application-1-body
text: Directional audio could reduce manual aiming as speakers move or take turns.

name: application-2-body
text: Direction estimates support turning toward a voice. Speaker-gated mode adds authorization for an enrolled user.

name: ui-body
